“ Do you... Think I look like Blackberry Cookie? „

Pumpkin Moon Witch (Korean: ) is Blackberry Cookie's third Costume, released in the second half of the Our Special Pie Party! update. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained by drawing it from the annual Halloween Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

A truly spooky, captivating party is held each year on the Night of the Pumpkin Moon! However, many Cookies lose their way before making it there even with their way lit by the large harvest moon. Each of them encounters Blackberry Cookie, who leads them back onto the right path. Don't look too closely at the crowd following behind her, for there may be beings other than Cookies looking back at you.

Trivia

  • Pumpkin Moon Witch was released alongside  Bountiful Pie Day,  Moonlight for a Day,  Sea Fairy for a Day, Unknown: everypie c1,  Full Moon Party Planner,  Dreamcatcher for a Day, and  Sea Bubble for a Day.
  • Pumpkin Moon Witch's quotes allude to Pumpkin Moon Witch possibly not being Blackberry Cookie at all, and instead only an apparition.

"Guest Lecturer for the Ghost Stories Class"

“ What makes you think you are taking this class alone? „

Professor, Paranormal 101 (Korean: 괴담 수업 초청강사, gwedam suop chochonggangsa, "Guest Lecturer for the Ghost Stories Class") is Blackberry Cookie's second Costume released in the first half of the Spooky School Experience update. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Blackberry Cookie conducts a secretive class full of spine-chilling stories after school, and she reads them out loud in her calm voice. By the end of class, the students get goosebumps all over their dough. Is it only because of the stories...? Or did they see something...?

Trivia

  • Professor, Paranormal 101 was released alongside  Eerie Classroom Pupil.
  • Professor, Paranormal 101's sketch designs reveals that Blackberry Cookie was originally intended to have a student-esque design, before switching to a professor design instead.
  • As part of the theming in the Spooky School Experience update, Professor, Paranormal 101's book contains a pentagram.

"Starring Role of the Elegant Rest"

“ I have not had a respite for a while... „

Elegant Respite (Korean: 우아한 휴식의 주연, uahan hyusige juyon, "Starring Role of the Elegant Rest") is Blackberry Cookie's first Costume, released in the first half of the Spooky Spider Mansion update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Elegant and graceful, Blackberry Cookie slowly sips her tea as she enjoys the brief respite of the banquet. Though she prepared the banquet for Adventurer Cookie, it's as if the spotlight is on her. But who gifted her that new candlestick?

Trivia

  • Elegant Respite was released alongside  Accidental Host.
  • Elegant Respite and  Accidental Host's gacha illustrations make one big picture when put together side by side.
  • According to concept notes, Elegant Respite was based on Cinderella. It appears that Blackberry Cookie may be wearing a ghostly outfit over her normal clothes, and similarly to Cinderella, it disappears at the "end of the night," or in this case, the end of the run.
  • The Cookie that gave Blackberry Cookie the new candle was Adventurer Cookie, as confirmed in the ending of Spooky Spider Mansion's story.
  • Elegant Respite has one of the more significant changes in animation in contrast to some previously released Super Epic Costumes. This is especially highlighted for the collision animation where the ghosts break Blackberry Cookie's fall.
